description: This source file defines the implementation of MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) hooks for PyTorch, including initialization, device management, memory management, profiling, and event handling functionalities within the at::mps namespace.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes MPS hooks, sets up necessary devices and streams.

methods.name: hasMPS
methods.description: Checks if MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) is available on the current device.

methods.name: isOnMacOSorNewer
methods.description: Determines whether the current OS version is MacOS or newer based on specified major and minor version numbers.

methods.name: getMPSDeviceAllocator
methods.description: Retrieves the allocator used for MPS devices.

methods.name: getDefaultGenerator
methods.description: Returns the default MPS generator for the specified device index.

methods.name: getNewGenerator
methods.description: Creates and returns a new MPS generator for the specified device index.

methods.name: deviceSynchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the default MPS stream.

methods.name: commitStream
methods.description: Commits the current MPS stream.

methods.name: getCommandBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the command buffer from the default MPS stream, ending kernel coalescing first.

methods.name: getDispatchQueue
methods.description: Returns the dispatch queue associated with the default MPS stream.

methods.name: emptyCache
methods.description: Empties the MPS memory cache.

methods.name: getCurrentAllocatedMemory
methods.description: Returns the current allocated memory size in MPS.

methods.name: getDriverAllocatedMemory
methods.description: Returns the driver-allocated memory size in MPS.

methods.name: getRecommendedMaxMemory
methods.description: Returns the recommended maximum allocatable memory for MPS.

methods.name: setMemoryFraction
methods.description: Sets the high watermark ratio for MPS memory usage.

methods.name: profilerStartTrace
methods.description: Starts a profiling trace with the specified mode, optionally waiting until completion.

methods.name: profilerStopTrace
methods.description: Stops the current profiling trace.

methods.name: acquireEvent
methods.description: Acquires a new event ID from the MPS event pool, with optional timing.

methods.name: releaseEvent
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired event ID.

methods.name: recordEvent
methods.description: Records an event, optionally synchronizing.

methods.name: getDeviceFromPtr
methods.description: Returns the device associated with a given data pointer.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for an event to complete.

methods.name: synchronizeEvent
methods.description: Synchronizes an event.

methods.name: queryEvent
methods.description: Queries the status of an event.

methods.name: elapsedTimeOfEvents
methods.description: Calculates the elapsed time between two events.

methods.name: isPinnedPtr
methods.description: Checks if a data pointer is pinned memory.

methods.name: getPinnedMemoryAllocator
methods.description: Retrieves the pinned memory allocator.
